name: skills
description: Skills for writing skills. First: author-setup-skill, which interviews an author about a setup they want to automate, scaffolds the setup skill's SKILL.md and a dependency-free Python or node step script (named steps, --dry-run, --root, reuse-don't-clobber, owned or joined state) from that interview, repo-local or shipped in a plugin, optionally copies in the setup-observer that watches each run and files what the guide got wrong, then audits both — the fifteen-lesson recipe learned building the doc-workspace setup skills.
